ns2:course.label: Energy Systems
ns2:course.description: (NPRE 201) Examines patterns of energy production and utilization and discusses the technical aspects of renewable energy resources, advanced fossil fuel systems and advanced nuclear systems. Same as GLBL 201. Prerequisite: MATH 220; one of PHYS 101, PHYS 211, CHEM 104, CHEM 204, or ME 300.
